_note: Sanctuary wings (bible §7, §9): each opens through the story (owner's call, Chapter 1): its chapter's quest sets the flags in 'after' (and 'owned': Patchlings the four have between them). 'needs' is what PATCH says it waits on. Restoring one fixes part of Verrow's ecology and pushes back the Tally. Bestiary points (engine/progress.ts sanctuaryPoints) are for filling the rooms in over time, not for wings. 'patch': what PATCH says when it's restored.

wings.name: Root Hall
wings.needs: Seal your first wild Patchling. The roots only wake up for a keeper who's actually kept something.
wings.desc: The old keepers' hall, roots through every stone. Restoring it settles the hills around Hollow Rest.

patch.text: Root Hall: restored. The hills feel less... drafty.
One wing. The Tally won't like that. I'm working on the rest.

wings.name: Lantern Loft
wings.needs: The keepers watched for storms from up there. No storms, no point. Route 1 hasn't had one in years.
wings.desc: The keepers' lookout above Root Hall: a round room of windows and old paintings. Restoring it lets the storms reach Hollow Rest again.

patch.text: Lantern Loft: restored. The weather can find Hollow Rest again.
The paintings were already up there. I did not paint them. I would remember.

wings.name: Tide Gallery
wings.needs: Something in Kettleport's harbour remembers these halls. That's Chapter 2.
wings.desc: Flooded halls of shell and glass. Something in Kettleport's harbour remembers them.

patch.text: Tide Gallery: restored. Kettleport's water is behaving again.

wings.name: Ember Vault
wings.needs: Cold for a hundred years. Emberwick's glassblowers want it lit. Later chapter.
wings.desc: A kiln under the sanctuary, cold for a hundred years. Emberwick's glassblowers want it lit.

patch.text: Ember Vault: restored. It's warm. I'm choosing to take that as a compliment.
